title: approve-enrollment
description: Approve a pending cabinet: where it belongs, what it is called and its role. A satellite may name the sync cabinet it reaches (an active sync cabinet at the same site); left out, it is linked to the site's only sync cabinet, or stays incomplete until one is assigned.

syncCabinetId.description: The sync cabinet this satellite reaches. Only a satellite names one.

scanner.description: For a new client only: whether it uses a fingerprint scanner, with its service when it does. An existing client keeps its own setting, so the approval refuses this field for one (change it on the client's page).

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.

not.description: Only a satellite reaches a sync cabinet. Refusing the field on another role is clearer than ignoring it.
